snippet.title: Crimson Horror - DOOM WAD TRAILER
snippet.description:
#doom #trailer 

DOWNLOAD RC1 HERE: https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/155461-crimson-horror-rc1-release-thread-mbf21/

Just in time for the spooky season, EduardoAndFriends presents a new 8 level Doom mapset filled with magic, mayhem, and SO. MUCH. RED.

You step in to the church's gloom, 
Summoned to face an unknown Doom,
In a land of dark magic where trouble looms,
And a people cry out 'midst a plague's sickly bloom
To Dunmere you must fly, through forests and caves,
Though citadels and fortresses shall bar the way
Before the Witch King you stand in his tower of red,
One must survive and one ... must be dead.

Follow the link above to the release thread for further information!
